# APKEditor

Vendored APKEditor used by `android-feature-01-risk-02` to merge an app's base
and split APKs into one APK before `apktool` decodes it. Resolved by
repository-relative path (the newest `tools/vendor/apkeditor/APKEditor*.jar`),
or by `repackaging.apkeditor_jar` when set. It needs `java` on `PATH`.

- Upstream: [REAndroid/APKEditor](https://github.com/REAndroid/APKEditor)
- Committed build: `APKEditor-1.4.9.jar` from release V1.4.9, SHA-256
  `a9cd40df818845456be6d696de6110c89edf4b0a0580cb83438ed6b25a366e67`.
